notes.title: A little update! v1.0.e
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864167/e8badfaa4f995dd75b9c8009025ed2934959d9d2.jpg

Hello everyone!

As you know our game Lyndaria: Lust Adventure has been released on Steam for a while now! We have received a lot of your feedback and we are trying to clean up all the rough issues that we had.
For example, as you know, we added autosaves. But those saves broke other things in the game 🙈 That's why we fixed everything quickly and released the update after the tests. So what's today? And today we have another update 😁

What's fixed:
- Fixes typos in dialogs
- Fixes animations, scenes and some pictures in the gallery
- Auto-save fixes
- Cathay and Astra characters are now highlighted and voiced when they don't have names

What was added:
- Added proofreaded French language

Many thanks to the translators who try and proofread the text!
By the way, whoever guesses the number of words by writing an even number first will get a key to Lyndaria or DLC (animation pack or artbook) of the winner's choice!

*Even number, we mean 1000,2500, not 6754 😅

notes.title: New Update! v0.1c
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864167/cd71e1231af60733c6106c092862d1ee095c97b9.png

✨Hello, our favourite gamers!
Congratulations to everyone on the release of Lyndaria. Many thanks to all the players for your support! 💓
Everything went smoothly and there were no critical bugs. We are very happy about it, because we tried to fix most of the bugs early on. 💪🏻

However, it was not without minor bugs... We are also trying to reproduce and fix little issues that you had. We are working on our mistakes :)

Thank you for writing us comments or letting us know about problems in Discord. We realized you were missing autosaves and quickly tried to write code for them, testing on dev builds all the time since release, and then pouring 5 updates on Steam to make sure everything was working as intended and update you. So if you've noticed version updates, know that we've been doing some quick tests. But now we're 99% sure that autosaves are working properly, and we're ready to let you know for sure! 😋

Please report any bugs, even minor issues, on our Discord channel, and we'll fix them immediately in the next update. 

Here's what we've fixed so far:

- Added autosave (now it's safe to play)
- Fixed minor bugs in quests, locations and scenes.

The update is already out on Steam. So check it out 😘

💓 Also we want to ask you: what do you really like about the game? Write your answers in the comments, we'll read them later with the whole team 💓

notes.title: RELEASE on Steam - September 20!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864167/65a371f4fd7dd7d4c17a476b875002128ec646f1.png

🌴 Hello, tropical island visitors!
We have a release coming up. Decided to add some stats and take a look back. Let's reflect on how much and what we have in the game. We'll also look back at the lore a little bit more. Sit back and make yourself comfortable 🥰

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864167/6ee065bfd42c9775a12b780897de529b162e2b2d.png

❗️ Let's reveal the cards right away: RELEASE on September 20. Add it to your wishlists so you don't miss it ❗️

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2781250/Lyndaria_Lust_Adventure/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864167/f89f5d4956abf23b44d5f353568b84ee769c7c31.png

🍑 26 characters. Humans, gods, kujin, akami, and other inhabitants of the island. Each of them plays a different role in the story. Some you won't even realize how important their role is
⚙️ 12 mechanics. Free movement, upgrading characteristics, relationships, and more. Some of them you're used to and don't even notice, but we polish each mechanic. So there's something for everyone to do on the island
🎨 21 cutscenes and 74 backgrounds. We have also provided for day-night change on the map, each background has both night and morning variants. In the cutscenes (we call static art during the narrative) we show the most important events

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864167/abd1aec910e6371d286b1ce22fe28816ff2d3dd2.png

In general, the story of Lyndaria began in February 2023. You wouldn't have recognized our game like this back then. A lot of work was also done during the rewrite. Just in June 2023 we decided that we need variability and free movement. And so, we're hoping to be done in September 2024.

Did you know we've even thought through the lore of each tribe? Buildings, totems, subtleties and nuances aren't just added to the text and art for no reason. There's meaning behind it all. We looked for historical references for each tribe, so that we could see their development at once. For example, the Atlantes are the remnants of an ancient civilization. They even have a system of rulers like in ancient Rome.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864167/e162d2b1be420662455bba021aca9c1ec2cb503f.jpg

We tried to bring together all the inhabitants of the island. They can exchange cultural traditions, but they can also fight. However, even the mighty ruler of the Kujins realizes that it's not profitable to fight the whole island. Suddenly, the charming Maya appears among them! The story turns and plays with new colors 💞

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44864167/0844ba5d1e20b8eb76bacfcbef27421b00520493.png

Our traveler may develop the closest relationships with a lot of characters. However, along the way she will also see war, loss, and the conflict of the gods. What do you think of such an adventure in the world of adult games?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2781250/Lyndaria_Lust_Adventure/
